review_candidates.description: Descrição da vaga Somos o Grupo Energisa! Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro. Nosso portfólio diversificado abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás. Transformamos, através de nossos mais de 17.000 colaboradores, energia em conforto e desenvolvimento para mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e da pluralidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Aqui todos são muito bem-vindos! Quer fazer parte desta história? Confere se esta oportunidade tem match com o seu perfil e vem conosco participar desta jornada de seleção! Responsabilidades e atribuições Estudar, realizar e acompanhar o desempenho do sistema elétrico; Analisar projetos elétricos de redes e linhas de distribuição e edificações; Elaborar projetos elétricos de redes e linhas de distribuição; Acompanhar e fiscalizar obras de distribuição realizadas por pessoal próprio ou terceiros; Inspecionar redes e linhas de distribuição, identificando os pontos a serem manutencionados e coordenando a execução das manutenções programadas, corretivas e de emergência em redes e linhas de distribuição; Monitorar e controlar os processos e equipes técnicas e comerciais, no sentido de garantir o atendimento comercial e técnico operacional ao cliente, dentro dos padrões estabelecidos pela empresa e órgãos reguladores e legisladores do setor elétrico; Executar medições de redes, linhas, transformadores e equipamentos para atender as diretrizes da ANEEL e do planejamento regional; Inspecionar e acompanhar o desempenho de equipamentos de redes, linhas e subestações, prestando apoio às equipes de manutenção de linhas e redes; Analisar alternativas para solução de problemas de qualidade e continuidade do sistema elétrico; Manter relacionamento com demais órgãos da empresa, dentro da matriz de interfuncionalidade; Aprimorar a qualidade do serviço prestado ao cliente externo e interno; Executar estudos de seletividade e proteção do sistema elétrico; Realizar levantamento de cadastro de linhas, redes, equipamentos de distribuição de energia elétrica; Realizar o preenchimento de planilhas de controle do processo de inspeção e manutenção de linhas de redes da distribuição; Realizar a análise dos processos de ressarcimento de danos elétricos, buscando o atendimento ao PRODIST; Realizar atividades do Centro de Operação da Distribuição, atendendo ocorrências técnicas e comerciais; Negociar orçamentos de projetos de terceiros; Acompanhar equipes terceirizadas em campo, realizando a medição dos serviços para emissão de notas fiscais; Elaborar orçamentos dos projetos; Encerrar tecnicamente as obras de distribuição; Atualizar as Buits dos projetos; Realizar visitas de inspeções a clientes de Média Tensão para avaliação da qualidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica; Realizar avaliação de fenômenos transitórios da rede (harmônicos, flutuações de tensão, variação momentânea de tensão, desequilíbrio). Requisitos e qualificações Ensino médio completo; Curso Técnico em Eletrotécnica/Eletromecânica; Curso de NR 10; Curso de NR 10-SEP; Conhecimento Pacote office intermediário; Desejável experiência de 01 a 2 anos realizando atividades de serviços elétricos. Informações adicionais As PESSOAS são nossa maior ENERGIA. Pensando em seu bem-estar, oferecemos um leque de benefícios. Da só uma conferida no que você terá: Vale alimentação ou Refeição para fazer as compras para sua casa ou comer no seu restaurante preferido; Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família; Previdência privada para sua reserva financeira e investimentos; Auxílio Creche para te apoiar nos primeiros anos com seus filhos; Seguro de Vida, para dar mais tranquilidade a você e a quem você ama; Participação nos lucros, como incentivo pelo seu trabalho e resultados; Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar e promovem a saúde dos nossos colaboradores; Programas de Bolsa de Estudo para te apoiar em qualificação profissional; Gympass que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil. Se você possui os pré requisitos da vaga, faça sua candidatura e fique atento nas dicas: Durante a jornada do processo de seleção, a comunicação será via e-mail ou por telefone. Certifique que seus dados estão atualizados e fique de olho na sua caixa de e-mail, sem esquecer da caixa de spam. Fique atento nas ligações, os nossos telefones corporativos possuem variação de DDD. Caso receba um feedback negativo, não desanime, fique atento a outras oportunidades. Talentos que fazem a diferença. Venha fazer parte do Grupo Energisa! ☀️ Você sabia que somos um dos maiores grupos do setor elétrico brasileiro? Com 120 anos de história, somos um ecossistema de produtos e serviços voltado para liderar a transformação energética, conectando pessoas e empresas à melhor solução de energia e construindo um mundo mais sustentável. Atuamos em 977 municípios de todas as regiões do Brasil, levando energia a mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Nosso trabalho mais visível é na distribuição de energia, mas temos muito mais a oferecer. Além das 9 distribuidoras de energia elétrica e 13 concessões de transmissão, contamos com uma central de geração fotovoltaica centralizada e um dos maiores parques de geração distribuída fotovoltaica do país, com a nossa marca inovadora (re)energisa. Também operamos no Mercado Livre de Energia, oferecendo soluções de valor agregado para nossos clientes. Além disso, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a distribuição e comercialização de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás, e, desde novembro de 2024, com a participação nos ativos da Cegás, Copergás, Algás e Potigás. Estamos também investindo na geração, distribuição e comercialização de bio soluções, como biogás, biometano e biofertilizante, através da Agric. Nossa missão é transformar energia em conforto, desenvolvimento e novas possibilidades com sustentabilidade. E para isso, contamos com cerca de 17 mil colaboradores que fazem a diferença todos os dias. Você também pode ser parte dessa história de transformação. Vamos juntos construir um mundo mais sustentável?

As a 100% employee-owned and operated firm, with over 1,500 staff members in 31 locations, we are proud to offer qualified staff with shareholding options in our company. At McElhanney, we work in teams to build strong connections with our staff, clients, and local communities. Our employees enjoy working here because of our varied projects, high levels of autonomy, opportunities for career development, excellent total compensation and benefits package, and collaborating with a team of great professionals. The Opportunity McElhanney has an exciting opportunity for a Transportation Design Engineer or Technologist to join our growing Calgary team. If you’re passionate about designing safe, efficient, and community‑focused transportation infrastructure, this role offers the chance to work on impactful projects across Western Canada. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary group of engineers, technologists, planners, and project managers to deliver innovative solutions for municipal, provincial, and private‑sector clients. This is a great fit for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, enjoys solving complex design challenges, and is looking to grow their technical and leadership skills within an employee‑owned firm. This position is Calgary based and offers the flexibility of remote work. What You’ll Do Lead and support the design of roadways, intersections, active transportation facilities, transit corridors, and site‑access improvements. Coordinate the preparation geometric designs including horizontal/vertical alignments, intersections, grading, drainage, and corridor models. Complete ancillary design tasks such as signage, pavement marking, barrier warrants and drainage assessments. Develop design reports, cost estimates, tender packages, and construction specifications. Collaborate with internal teams across geomatics, transportation planning, municipal engineering , and construction services. Attend meetings, present design concepts, and support public engagement activities when required. Assist with proposal production and business development. review_candidates.title: Telecom OSS Architect / Designer
review_candidates.description: At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. Your Role As a Telecom OSS Architect / Designer , you will be a senior technical authority within our Connectivity & Network Engineering practice, leading the architecture and design of complex OSS solutions for major telecoms clients in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery, working closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendor partners to define and implement best-in-class OSS ecosystems. In this role you will play a key role in: Leading end-to-end OSS architecture and design across Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management domains — defining solution blueprints, integration frameworks, and technical roadmaps aligned to client business objectives and industry best practices such as TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID). Driving the design and implementation of Network Inventory solutions, including physical, logical, and service inventory modelling, ensuring accurate and real-time representation of network assets across multi-vendor, multi-technology environments (2G/3G/4G/5G, Fixed, IP/MPLS). Architecting Performance and Fault Management solutions, overseeing the design of KPI frameworks, threshold management, alarm correlation, and root cause analysis capabilities — enabling proactive network operations and minimising service impact for telecoms operators. Engaging directly with senior client stakeholders to gather and translate complex business and operational requirements into detailed technical specifications, solution architectures, and HLD/LLD documentation, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the solution lifecycle. Leading and governing OSS integration design, defining interfaces and APIs between OSS platforms and adjacent systems including BSS, NMS, EMS, and emerging cloud-native network management platforms — ensuring seamless data flows and operational continuity across the network operations ecosystem. Providing technical leadership and mentoring to a team of OSS engineers and designers, conducting design reviews, driving quality assurance of technical deliverables, and ensuring architectural consistency and compliance with agreed standards across project workstreams. Supporting pre-sales and solutioning activities, contributing to RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and solution demonstrations — bringing deep domain expertise to help shape and win new opportunities across the KSA and wider Middle East telecoms market. Your Profile We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Telecom OSS Architect who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capability and a collaborative approach. Technical Skills & Experience: 12+ years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on OSS architecture, design, and delivery — including proven expertise in at least two of the following domains: Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management systems, ideally in large-scale, multi-vendor operator environments. Deep hands-on knowledge of OSS platforms and tools, such as IBM Tivoli Netcool, Nokia NetAct, Ericsson ENM/ENIQ, Huawei iMAC/U2000, Comarch OSS, or similar — combined with strong understanding of OSS/BSS integration patterns, mediation layers, and data modelling techniques for telecoms network domains. Strong grounding in TM Forum standards and frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID/ODA) and familiarity with relevant industry standards including 3GPP, ETSI, IETF, and TMN — with the ability to apply these frameworks pragmatically in real-world solution design and architecture. Solid experience with integration technologies and APIs including REST/SOAP web services, TMF Open APIs, OSS/J, XML/JSON data formats, and middleware platforms — with the ability to architect robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions between OSS components and broader network management ecosystems. Proficiency in producing high-quality architecture and design artefacts, including Solution Architecture Documents, HLDs, LLDs, interface control documents, data flow diagrams, and operational runbooks — with experience presenting these at both technical and executive levels. What You'll Love About Working Here Dedicated Innovation Labs – We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics such as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum. As a Telecom OSS Architect at Capgemini Engineering, you will be at the heart of this innovation — shaping the next generation of network operations for some of the world's leading operators. Career Acceleration Programs – From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise. With 12+ years of experience, you'll have access to programmes designed specifically to take senior engineers to the next level. Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services – Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleash their R&D potential to develop the smart products and services of tomorrow — and you will play a central role in that mission in the KSA market. Engineering Horizons – A global conference crafted exclusively for Capgemini Engineering colleagues, where excellence takes centre stage. Immerse yourself in opportunities to showcase your talents and connect with the brightest minds in engineering across the planet — building your professional network and visibility on a truly global stage. Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

review_candidates.description: Description Supply Chain Development Manager (APAC) Department: Supply Chain Management Reports To: VP-Supply Chain Location: Remote (India) with Regional Travel Industry: Power & Distribution Transformers, Electrical Equipment, Energy Infrastructure Company Description Sanmina Corporation is a global manufacturing & services company that supports diversified Customers with innovative products and manufacturing services. More details can be found at https://www.sanmina.com/ Business Unit Description The Power & Energy business is currently based out of a Greenfield facility in Houston, US. It’s geared up to provide a unique solution in a distribution transformer space designed & Engineered in technical collaboration with Sanmina’s Technology Partner from Europe. The opportunity is for a seasoned supplier quality professional with a robust track record of success and a strong technical foundation in developing & managing regional supply base to cater to the facilities & customers that are based globally. Job Purpose The Regional Supplier Quality Manager (SQM) – Mechanicals & Electro mechanicals is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuous execution of the supplier quality management strategy across regional supply chains for transformer manufacturing. This role ensures that all mechanical components (e.g., tanks, radiators, insulation materials, structural steel) and electromechanical assemblies (e.g., tap changers, bushings, control cabinets, sensors, cooling systems etc.) meet rigorous reliability, safety, and regulatory standards. Key Responsibilities Supplier Qualification & Auditing Supplier Quality Management System Audit: Lead comprehensive supplier quality audits (VDA 6.3, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 as applicable) for prospective and active suppliers across the region. Component Qualification: Manage the approval process for new mechanical and electromechanical components using APQP and PPAP methodologies (or equivalent industry frameworks). Technical Capability Assessment: Evaluate supplier manufacturing processes, welding quality (e.g., ISO 3834 / AWS D1.1), non-destructive testing (NDT), surface treatment/coatings (C5-I/M ISO 12944 environments), and electromechanical integration.
